def _get_publish(self):
        """
        Find this publish on remote
        """
        publish_id = self.data.get("publish_id")
        if not publish_id:
            raise ValueError("publish_id is required")

        publish = self.api.publish.get(publish_id)
        if not publish:
            raise ValueError("publish not found")

        return publish
